metadata.name: fanex_curve
metadata.description: Fanex on-chain bonding curve: strip-proof atomic creator/Fanex fee split, presale curve, creator vesting, and merkle dividend distributor. Replaces Raydium LaunchLab for the presale phase (graduation still hands off to Raydium CPMM).

accounts.name: claim_status
docs: only read the new one; owner, discriminator and seeds are all verified

accounts.name: distributor
docs: DEAD (its account closed): while the distributor lives, the ClaimStatus
is the double-claim guard and closing it would re-open the claim.

accounts.name: rent_recipient
docs: on the new format, `claimant` on the legacy one — so a permissionless
caller can trigger the refund but never redirect it.

accounts.name: creator
docs: every buy and beneficiary of the vested 2%. Stored as `curve.creator` and
later enforced by `buy`/`sell`/`claim_vesting`. MAY differ from `launcher`
(admin-concierge). No signature is required: whoever pays the create tx

accounts.name: metadata
docs: the Metaplex CPI in the handler derives + validates it against `mint` and
creates it. Mutable because the CPI initializes it.

accounts.name: metadata_update_authority
docs: Must equal `config.fanex_fee_wallet` so Fanex retains the ability to fix
